Mark it down, mi gente — the cards are coming back out 🃏🔥 Lesbians Playing Uno returns and this time it's falling on Dec. 13th, so clear your Sunday because the Draw Fours do not care about your plans. Jayme's hosting another round of cards, chisme, and new friendships (and betrayals, let's be real). Free entry means zero excuses — bring your people, bring your competitive streak, and get ready to fight over who actually knows the house rules. This is the kind of night that fills up fast once word gets out, so don't be the one hearing about it Sunday morning. Pull up early, grab a seat at the table, and let the chaos begin 💛

🗓️ Sunday, December 13th — 7PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Free Entry
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #LesbiansPlayingUno #UnoNight #PascoWA #LatinxCommunity #FreeEntry #SundayFunday

Cards slapping the table, laughter bouncing off the walls, somebody already yelling 'UNO' before they've even thought it through 🃏✨ That's the scene Jayme's cooking up again — a room full of chisme, drinks in hand, and the kind of energy that makes a card game feel like an event. You can feel the chaos before you even sit down. Every Draw Two hits different when it's aimed at your friend across the table. Every round builds, every reversal gets a reaction, and before you know it hours have passed and you're still there, laughing, plotting your next move. It's low-key but it sneaks up on you in the best way. Come feel it for yourself 💫

🗓️ Sunday, December 13th — 7PM

Come as you are, cards or no card skills required 🫶🃏 Lesbians Playing Uno is that space where you don't need an invite to belong — just show up. Jayme hosts this one with zero judgment energy, so whether you're a Uno strategist or you still mix up Draw Two and Draw Four, you've got a seat at this table. It's about the people as much as it is the game — meeting someone new, reconnecting with a familiar face, building community one round at a time. Bring your crew, bring your favorite order, and settle in for a Sunday that reminds you why this space matters. Everyone's welcome here, exactly as they are 💛
